monster.name: MON_Baboon

trait.name: Pack Tactics
trait.text: The baboon has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the baboon's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

monster.description: Screaming, aggressive monkeys trapped in the crates of Warehouse 4. When a crate breaks open, they escape in pairs — terrified and furious. They throw objects, snatch things from PCs' hands, and create general chaos. Role: exotic animal escaped from crates

monster.name: MON_GiantWolfSpider
monster.senses: Blindsight 10 ft., Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13

trait.name: Spider Climb
trait.text: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing an ability check.

trait.name: Web Sense
trait.text: While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Web Walker
trait.text: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Bite (melee)
action.text: Attack: +3, melee 5ft Damage: 1d6+1 piercing + 2d6 poison (CON DC 11, halved)

monster.description: A dog-sized spider, hairy, with eight black eyes and dripping mandibles. It drops from the ceiling beams when its crate breaks. Moves fast across crates and walls. Role: exotic animal escaped from crates

monster.name: MON_PoisonousSnake

action.name: Bite (melee)
action.text: Attack: +5, melee 5ft Damage: 1 piercing + 2d4 poison (CON DC 10, halved)

monster.description: Thin, fast snakes — dark green with yellow stripes. They slither out of broken crates and hide among barrels and nets. They bite anyone who gets too close. Role: exotic animal escaped from crates

monster.name: MON_Rhinoceros

trait.name: Charge
trait.text: If the rhinoceros moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 2d8 bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

monster.description: A grey rhinoceros, enormous, furious. Trapped in a reinforced crate in Warehouse 4 of Vetusta Portus. It's not an enemy — it's a terrified animal that wants to escape. It only attacks those in its path toward the door. Role: exotic animal trapped in the warehouse

monster.name: Bandit
monster.description: Port men of Vetusta Portus. Dockworkers, ex-sailors, petty criminals. They work for Er Braccio for easy money. They're not fanatics — if things go south, they run. Role: Er Braccio's henchman

monster.name: Contessina

trait.name: Parry
trait.text: The Countess adds 2 to her AC against one melee attack that would hit her. She must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

monster.description: A stout woman with a round face and a permanently indignant expression. She dresses well but without taste — too many jewels, too many colors. She speaks with a thick accent and gesticulates a lot. She holds down the castle in Aviano while the Count is "traveling" (i.e., always). She knows about the blackmail but her main concern is her own reputation, not her husband. Role: noblewoman, wife of the Count of Fianus

monster.name: Domina Lella

action.name: **Rolling Pin.** +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 1d4+2 bludgeoning damage.
DM Notes
action.text: Doesn't fight seriously, but the rolling pin is a credible threat at the table. STR 14 and Intimidation reflect the fact that nobody in Fianus Romanus dares contradict her. Knows everything about everyone, but you have to pay her or treat her well to get her to talk.

monster.description: - Practical, direct, zero diplomacy - Enormous portions, precise bill - Knows everything about everyone in Fianus Romanus, but information costs - The rolling pin isn't just for cooking

monster.name: ErBraccio

trait.name: Multiattack
trait.text: Er Braccio makes three melee attacks: two with his scimitar and one with his dagger.

action.name: Dagger (melee/ranged)
action.text: Attack: +5, melee 5ft or ranged 20/60 ft. Damage: 1d4+3 piercing

monster.description: A massive man with bare arms and an anchor tattoo on his right bicep. Sits on a crate with a knife in one hand and an apple in the other. He runs the port's smuggling operations from Warehouse 4. He's not stupid — he's a businessman who happens to be a criminal. He has a grudge against the Count for ruining his trade with new taxes. Role: bandit leader, port crime boss

monster.name: Flavia
monster.description: A thin woman with quick eyes and black hair gathered under a colorful headscarf. She moves between the markets of Fianus and Vetusta Portus selling herbs, ointments, and folk remedies. They call her "The Snake" for how she slips away when things go bad. Before the Gabella she also sold "La Rocca Imponente" invigorating potions — she bought them from an anonymous intermediary at the port. Role: former seller of invigorating potions

monster.name: The Count

trait.name: Parry
trait.text: +2 to AC against one melee attack that would hit. Must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

monster.description: Whose name nobody knows, whose face nobody has seen. The Count is the instigator of everything — he sent Gorim, he wants the Ring, he governs the territory — but nobody can name him, describe him, or meet him. He is a constant and totally absent presence. His personality is a mosaic of contradictory accounts: to some he's generous, to others he's miserly, to others still he's mad. The orders he sends are inconsistent — sometimes reasonable, sometimes absurd. **Running gag — the name:** every time an NPC is about to say it, they get interrupted (noise, sneeze, collapse, sudden amnesia). Official letters have the seal but the signature is illegible. **Running gag — the face:** no NPC has ever seen him in person. Official portraits are always covered, damaged, or turned backwards. The Count is NOT Dorian Valemarch. He's a local noble, a vassal of the King, who governs Fianus Romanus. Role: Living MacGuffin, quest giver

monster.name: SergiusArimano

trait.name: Sneak Attack (2d6)
trait.text: once per turn, extra damage if he has advantage or an ally is adjacent to the target

trait.name: Cunning Action
trait.text: bonus action: Dash, Disengage, or Hide

trait.name: Assassinate
trait.text: advantage on attack rolls against creatures that haven't acted yet. Automatic critical hit against surprised creatures.

trait.name: Ring of Shadows (magic item)
trait.text: can cast *Invisibility* (on self) 1/day. Doesn't require concentration but ends if he attacks or casts a spell.

action.name: Dagger (melee/ranged)
action.text: Attack: +5, melee 5ft / 1sq or ranged 20ft / 4sq — 60ft / 12sq Damage: 1d4+3 piercing (+2d6 Sneak Attack if applicable)

action.name: Hand Crossbow (ranged)
action.text: Attack: +5, ranged 30ft / 6sq — 120ft / 24sq Damage: 1d6+3 piercing (+2d6 Sneak Attack if applicable)

monster.description: The Sergio of Boris: a schemer, underhanded, pulling strings behind the scenes. Former owner of "L'Immane Alabarda," he sold vigor potions and personalized erotic portraits to the nobles of Fianus. The Count was an excellent client — he had an "artistic" portrait commissioned that he never paid for. The Count's wife (a prude) discovered everything and had the "Gabella Pudicitiae" imposed on all risqué merchandise. Marchese Arimano went from legitimate merchant to smuggler, and now he's getting his revenge. He fortuitously found the Count's Ring in the sewers and uses it as the instrument of an elaborate revenge — a public treasure hunt that humiliates the Count. He still has the unpaid portrait and uses it as leverage. Extremely intelligent, always three steps ahead of everyone. Speaks little, smiles a lot — the smile of someone who knows something you don't. Doesn't get his hands dirty if he can avoid it. Vain about his cunning: he leaves clues because he wants people to know it was him. The double S is his signature — ego disguised as anonymity. **Master of disguise:** regularly disguises himself as Terzilio the greengrocer (and others). Has a network of informants in the village (Varys/GOT type). Possesses a magical invisibility item. Sometimes the PCs talk to him without knowing it. Role: hidden antagonist

monster.name: SirGorimVel

trait.name: Action Surge (1/short rest)
trait.text: one additional action on his turn

trait.name: Rallying Cry
trait.text: when he uses Second Wind, up to 3 allies within 60ft / 12sq recover 3 HP each. Mechanically: Gorim shouts "MOVE IT, COME ON!" and everyone feels slightly better, more from fear than inspiration.

action.name: Longsword (melee)
action.text: Attack: +4, melee, reach 5ft / 1sq Damage: 1d8+2 slashing (1d10+2 two-handed without shield)

action.name: Dagger (melee/ranged)
action.text: Attack: +4, melee 5ft / 1sq or ranged 20ft / 4sq — 60ft / 12sq Damage: 1d4+2 piercing

monster.description: The René Ferretti of Fianus Romanus. Former captain of the Drakenhold garrison, assigned to serve as the Count's official in Fianus Romanus as a "promotion" — actually a disguised exile. A soldier forced to be a bureaucrat. Constantly exasperated by the incompetence surrounding him. Pragmatic to the core, allergic to pointless heroism. Gesticulates a lot, gets exasperated easily, talks to himself. Has a weakness for food (his belly confirms it). **Pathological stinginess:** Every time he has to pay the PCs, the scene must be an ordeal. Gorim doesn't want to do it in any way. He counts coins one by one, sighs at each coin, looks for excuses to pay less ("that wasn't information, that was an opinion"), asks for receipts, tries to pay in kind ("I'll give you a ham, it's the same"), proposes installments, accuses the PCs of not having done enough. No matter the amount — even 5 silver pieces cause him physical pain. Recurring phrases adapted from Ferretti: - "Come on come on come on, we can do this" (he doesn't believe it) - "Splendid. Wonderful." (sarcastic) - "What are you doing?!" - "I can't take it anymore with you lot" Role: main ally, quest giver

monster.name: Thug

trait.name: Pack Tactics
trait.text: advantage on attack rolls if an ally is within 5 ft. of the target

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: Effect: The thug makes two melee attacks.

monster.description: Low-ranking thugs in Sergius's service. Disguised as porters or merchants, they blend into the crowd at the Festa del Grazie. They only intervene if Sergius is spotted, covering his escape. They're not loyal — after 1 round or as soon as 2 are wounded, the most wounded one flees. The others fight until surrender. *"They don't pay us enough for this!"* Role: Sergius's henchman
